children: AllianceBernstein Holding's chief executive, Seth Bernstein, is retiring early next year after a decade at the helm of the investment manager.
AllianceBernstein on Friday said Onur Erzan, who became president of the Nashville, Tenn., company in January, will take on the additional post of CEO on April 1, 2027.
Erzan, 50 years old, joined AllianceBernstein in 2021.
AllianceBernstein said Erzan will receive a base salary of $650,000 as president and CEO, and that his total 2027 compensation target would be $13.5 million.
Bernstein, who has been CEO since 2017, will remain a board member, the company said.

title: AllianceBernstein Names Onur Erzan CEO as Seth Bernstein Retires
